categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet PSBT handling in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unexpected signing failure where FillPSBT and SignPSBTInput disagree on which UTXO to use when both witness_utxo and non_witness_utxo are present. While this addresses a clear PSBT signing failure for owned inputs, conflicting UTXO fields represent an edge case that can be reasonably deferred.
